final: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, v.player_id, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / NULLIF(v.points_max, 0)) AS player_avg FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max != 0 GROUP BY p.death_country, v.player_id), country_averages AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(player_avg) AS country_avg FROM player_averages GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, country_avg, country_avg / AVG(country_avg) OVER () AS relative_to_mean FROM country_averages
